functions.name: ABS

functions.name: ACCRINT
functions.summary: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays periodic interest.

functions.name: ACCRINTM
functions.summary: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays interest at maturity.

functions.name: ACOS
functions.summary: Returns the arccosine, or inverse cosine, of a number.

functions.name: ACOSH
functions.summary: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number.

functions.name: ACOT
functions.summary: Returns the arccotangent, or inverse cotangent, of a number.

functions.name: ACOTH
functions.summary: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cotangent of a number.

functions.name: ADDCOLUMNS
functions.summary: Adds calculated columns to the given table or table expression.

functions.name: ADDMISSINGITEMS
functions.summary: Adds combinations of items from multiple columns to a table if they do not already exist.

functions.name: ALL
functions.summary: Returns all the rows in a table, or all the values in a column, ignoring any filters that might have been applied.

functions.name: ALLCROSSFILTERED
functions.summary: Clear all filters which are applied to a table.

functions.name: ALLEXCEPT
functions.summary: Removes all context filters in the table except filters that have been applied to the specified columns.

functions.name: ALLNOBLANKROW

functions.name: ALLSELECTED
functions.summary: Removes context filters from columns and rows in the current query, while retaining all other context filters or explicit filters.

functions.name: ALLSELECTEDAPPLY
functions.summary: Modifies how filters are applied while evaluating a GROUPCROSSAPPLY or GROUPCROSSAPPLYTABLE function.

functions.name: ALLSELECTEDREMOVE
functions.summary: Modifies how filters are applied while evaluating a GROUPCROSSAPPLY or GROUPCROSSAPPLYTABLE function.

functions.name: ALWAYSAPPLY
functions.summary: Modifies how filters are applied while evaluating a GROUPCROSSAPPLY or GROUPCROSSAPPLYTABLE function.

functions.name: AMORDEGRC
functions.summary: Returns the depreciation for each accounting period. Similar to AMORLINC, except a depreciation coefficient is applied depending on the life of the assets.

functions.name: AMORLINC
functions.summary: Returns the depreciation for each accounting period.

functions.name: AND
functions.summary: Checks whether both arguments are `TRUE`, and returns `TRUE` if both arguments are `TRUE`.

functions.name: APPROXIMATEDISTINCTCOUNT
functions.summary: Returns an *estimated* count of unique values in a column.

functions.name: ASIN
functions.summary: Returns the arcsine, or inverse sine, of a number.

functions.name: ASINH
functions.summary: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number.

functions.name: ATAN
functions.summary: Returns the arctangent, or inverse tangent, of a number.

functions.name: ATANH
functions.summary: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number.

functions.name: AVERAGE
functions.summary: Returns the average (arithmetic mean) of all the numbers in a column.

functions.name: AVERAGEA
functions.summary: Returns the average (arithmetic mean) of the values in a column.

functions.name: AVERAGEX
functions.summary: Calculates the average (arithmetic mean) of a set of expressions evaluated over a table.

functions.name: BETA.DIST
functions.summary: Returns the beta distribution.

functions.name: BETA.INV
functions.summary: Returns the inverse of the beta cumulative probability density function (BETA.DIST).

functions.name: BITAND
functions.summary: Returns a bitwise 'AND' of two numbers.

functions.name: BITLSHIFT
functions.summary: Returns a number shifted left by the specified number of bits.

functions.name: BITOR
functions.summary: Returns a bitwise 'OR' of two numbers.

functions.name: BITRSHIFT
functions.summary: Returns a number shifted right by the specified number of bits.

functions.name: BITXOR
functions.summary: Returns a bitwise 'XOR' of two numbers.

functions.name: BLANK
functions.summary: Returns a blank.

functions.name: CALCULATE
functions.summary: Evaluates an expression in a modified filter context.

functions.name: CALCULATETABLE
functions.summary: Evaluates a table expression in a modified filter context.

functions.name: CALENDAR
functions.summary: Returns a table with a single column named "Date" that contains a contiguous set of dates.

functions.name: CALENDARAUTO
functions.summary: Returns a table with a single column named "Date" that contains a contiguous set of dates.

functions.name: CEILING
functions.summary: Rounds a number up, to the nearest integer or to the nearest multiple of significance.

functions.name: CHISQ.DIST
functions.summary: Returns the chi-squared distribution.

functions.name: CHISQ.DIST.RT
functions.summary: Returns the right-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

functions.name: CHISQ.INV
functions.summary: Returns the inverse of the left-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

functions.name: CHISQ.INV.RT
functions.summary: Returns the inverse of the right-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

functions.name: CLOSINGBALANCEMONTH
functions.summary: Evaluates the expression at the last date of the month in the current context.

functions.name: CLOSINGBALANCEQUARTER
functions.summary: Evaluates the expression at the last date of the quarter in the current context.

functions.name: CLOSINGBALANCEWEEK
functions.summary: Evaluates the expression at the last date of the week in the current context.

functions.name: CLOSINGBALANCEYEAR
functions.summary: Evaluates the expression at the last date of the year in the current context.

functions.name: COALESCE
functions.summary: Returns the first expression that does not evaluate to BLANK.

functions.name: COLLAPSE
functions.summary: Retrieves a context at a higher level compared to the current context. If an expression is provided, returns its value in the new context, allowing for navigation in hierarchies and calculation at a higher level.

functions.name: COLLAPSEALL
functions.summary: Retrieves a context at the highest level compared to the current context. If an expression is provided, returns its value in the new context, allowing for navigation in hierarchies and calculation at the highest level.

functions.name: COLUMNSTATISTICS
functions.summary: Returns a table of statistics regarding every column in every table in the model.

functions.name: COMBIN
functions.summary: Returns the number of combinations for a given number of items.

functions.name: COMBINA
functions.summary: Returns the number of combinations (with repetitions) for a given number of items.

functions.name: COMBINEVALUES
functions.summary: Joins two or more text strings into one text string.

functions.name: CONCATENATE
functions.summary: Joins two text strings into one text string.

functions.name: CONCATENATEX
functions.summary: Concatenates the result of an expression evaluated for each row in a table.

functions.name: CONFIDENCE.NORM
functions.summary: The confidence interval is a range of values.

functions.name: CONFIDENCE.T
functions.summary: Returns the confidence interval for a population mean, using a Student's t distribution.

functions.name: CONTAINS
functions.summary: Returns true if values for all referred columns exist, or are contained, in those columns; otherwise, the function returns false.

functions.name: CONTAINSROW
functions.summary: Returns `TRUE` if a row of values exists or contained in a table, otherwise returns `FALSE`.

functions.name: CONTAINSSTRING
functions.summary: Returns `TRUE` or `FALSE` indicating whether one string contains another string.

functions.name: CONTAINSSTRINGEXACT
functions.summary: Returns `TRUE` or `FALSE` indicating whether one string contains another string.

functions.name: CONVERT
functions.summary: Converts an expression of one data type to another.

functions.name: COS
functions.summary: Returns the cosine of the given angle.

functions.name: COSH
functions.summary: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a number.

functions.name: COT
functions.summary: Returns the cotangent of an angle specified in radians.

functions.name: COTH
functions.summary: Returns the hyperbolic cotangent of a hyperbolic angle.

functions.name: COUNT
functions.summary: Counts the number of rows in the specified column that contain non-blank values. Does not support Boolean values.

functions.name: COUNTA
functions.summary: Counts the number of rows in the specified column that contain non-blank values. Supports Boolean values.

functions.name: COUNTAX
functions.summary: Counts non-blank results when evaluating the result of an expression over a table.

functions.name: COUNTBLANK
functions.summary: Counts the number of blank cells in a column.

functions.name: COUNTROWS
functions.summary: Counts the number of rows in the specified table, or in a table defined by an expression.

functions.name: COUNTX
functions.summary: Counts the number of rows that contain a number or an expression that evaluates to a number, when evaluating an expression over a table.

functions.name: COUPDAYBS
functions.summary: Returns the number of days from the beginning of a coupon period until its settlement date.

functions.name: COUPDAYS
functions.summary: Returns the number of days in the coupon period that contains the settlement date.

functions.name: COUPDAYSNC
functions.summary: Returns the number of days from the settlement date to the next coupon date.

functions.name: COUPNCD
functions.summary: Returns the next coupon date after the settlement date.

functions.name: COUPNUM
functions.summary: Returns the number of coupons payable between the settlement date and maturity date, rounded up to the nearest whole coupon.

functions.name: COUPPCD
functions.summary: Returns the previous coupon date before the settlement date.

functions.name: CROSSFILTER
functions.summary: Specifies the cross-filtering direction to be used in a calculation for a relationship that exists between two columns.

functions.name: CROSSJOIN
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains the Cartesian product of all rows from all tables in the arguments.

functions.name: CUMIPMT
functions.summary: Returns the cumulative interest paid on a loan between start_period and end_period.

functions.name: CUMPRINC
functions.summary: Returns the cumulative principal paid on a loan between start_period and end_period.

functions.name: CURRENCY
functions.summary: Evaluates the argument and returns the result as currency data type.

functions.name: CURRENTGROUP
functions.summary: Returns a set of rows from the table argument of a GROUPBY expression.

functions.name: CUSTOMDATA
functions.summary: Returns the content of the CustomData property in the connection string.

functions.name: DATATABLE
functions.summary: Provides a mechanism for declaring an inline set of data values.

functions.name: DATE
functions.summary: Returns the specified date in datetime format.

functions.name: DATEADD
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains a column of dates, shifted either forward or backward in time by the specified number of intervals from the dates in the current context.

functions.name: DATEDIFF
functions.summary: Returns the number of interval boundaries between two dates.

functions.name: DATESBETWEEN
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains a column of dates that begins with a specified start date and continues until a specified end date.

functions.name: DATESINPERIOD
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains a column of dates that begins with a specified start date and continues for the specified number and type of date intervals.

functions.name: DATESMTD
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains a column of the dates for the month to date, in the current context.

functions.name: DATESQTD
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains a column of the dates for the quarter to date, in the current context.

functions.name: DATESWTD
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains a column of the dates for the week to date, in the current context.

functions.name: DATESYTD
functions.summary: Returns a table that contains a column of the dates for the year to date, in the current context.

functions.name: DATEVALUE
functions.summary: Converts a date in the form of text to a date in datetime format.

functions.name: DAY
functions.summary: Returns the day of the month, a number from 1 to 31.

functions.name: DB
functions.summary: Returns the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the fixed-declining balance method.

functions.name: DDB
functions.summary: Returns the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the double-declining balance method or some other method you specify.

functions.name: DEGREES
functions.summary: Converts radians into degrees.

functions.name: DEPENDON
functions.summary: Change the table expression to be dependent on outer columns, based on the table data.

functions.name: DETAILROWS
functions.summary: Evaluates a Detail Rows Expression defined for a measure and returns the data.

functions.name: DISC
functions.summary: Returns the discount rate for a security.

functions.name: DISTINCT column
functions.summary: Returns a one-column table that contains the distinct values from the specified column.

functions.name: DISTINCT table
functions.summary: Returns a table by removing duplicate rows from another table or expression.

functions.name: DISTINCTCOUNT
functions.summary: Counts the number of distinct values in a column.

functions.name: DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK
functions.summary: Counts the number of distinct values in a column.

functions.name: DIVIDE
functions.summary: Performs division and returns alternate result or BLANK() on division by 0.

functions.name: DOLLARDE
functions.summary: Converts a dollar price expressed as an integer part and a fraction part, such as 1.02, into a dollar price expressed as a decimal number.

functions.name: DOLLARFR
functions.summary: Converts a dollar price expressed as an integer part and a fraction part, such as 1.02, into a dollar price expressed as a decimal number.

functions.name: DURATION
functions.summary: Returns the Macauley duration for an assumed par value of $100.

functions.name: EARLIER
functions.summary: Returns the current value of the specified column in an outer evaluation pass of the mentioned column.

functions.name: EARLIEST
functions.summary: Returns the current value of the specified column in an outer evaluation pass of the specified column.

functions.name: EDATE
functions.summary: Returns the date that is the indicated number of months before or after the start date.

functions.name: EFFECT
functions.summary: Returns the effective annual interest rate, given the nominal annual interest rate and the number of compounding periods per year.

functions.name: ENDOFMONTH
functions.summary: Returns the last date of the month in the current context for the specified column of dates.

functions.name: ENDOFQUARTER
functions.summary: Returns the last date of the quarter in the current context for the specified column of dates.

functions.name: ENDOFWEEK
functions.summary: Returns the last date of the week in the current context for the specified column of dates.

functions.name: ENDOFYEAR
functions.summary: Returns the last date of the year in the current context for the specified column of dates.

functions.name: EOMONTH
functions.summary: Returns the date in datetime format of the last day of the month, before or after a specified number of months.

functions.name: ERROR
functions.summary: Raises an error with an error message.

functions.name: EVALUATEANDLOG
functions.summary: Returns the value of the first argument and logs it in a DAX Evaluation Log profiler event.

functions.name: EVEN
functions.summary: Returns number rounded up to the nearest even integer.

functions.name: EXACT
functions.summary: Compares two text strings and returns ``TRUE`` if they are exactly the same, `FALSE` otherwise.

functions.name: EXCEPT
functions.summary: Returns the rows of one table which do not appear in another table.

functions.name: EXP
functions.summary: Returns e raised to the power of a given number.

functions.name: EXPAND
functions.summary: Retrieves a context with added levels of detail compared to the current context. If an expression is provided, returns its value in the new context, allowing for navigation in hierarchies and calculation at a more detailed level.

functions.name: EXPANDALL
functions.summary: Retrieves a context at the most detailed level. If an expression is provided, returns its value in the new context, allowing for navigation in hierarchies and calculation at the most detailed level.

functions.name: EXPON.DIST
functions.summary: Returns the exponential distribution.

functions.name: EXTERNALMEASURE
functions.summary: Invokes a measure defined in a remote model and returns its result.

functions.name: FACT
functions.summary: Returns the factorial of a number, equal to the series 1*2\*3\*...\* , ending in the given number.

functions.name: FALSE
functions.summary: Returns the logical value `FALSE`.

functions.name: FILTER
functions.summary: Returns a table that represents a subset of another table or expression.

functions.name: FILTERCLUSTER
functions.summary: Returns a correlated join table over a set of groups.

functions.name: FILTERS
functions.summary: Returns a table of values directly applied as filters to `columnName`.

functions.name: FIND
functions.summary: Returns the starting position of one text string within another text string.

functions.name: FIRST
functions.summary: Used in visual calculations only. Retrieves a value in the visual matrix from the first row of an axis.

functions.name: FIRSTDATE
functions.summary: Returns the first date in the current context for the specified column of dates.

functions.name: FIRSTNONBLANK
functions.summary: Returns the first value in the column, `<column>`, filtered by the current context, where the expression is not blank.

functions.name: FIRSTNONBLANKVALUE
functions.summary: Evaluates an expression filtered by the sorted values of a column and returns the first value of the expression that is not blank.

functions.name: FIXED
functions.summary: Rounds a number to the specified number of decimals and returns the result as text.

functions.name: FLOOR
functions.summary: Rounds a number down, toward zero, to the nearest multiple of significance.

functions.name: FORMAT
functions.summary: Converts a value to text according to the specified format.

functions.name: FV
functions.summary: Calculates the future value of an investment based on a constant interest rate.

functions.name: GCD
functions.summary: Returns the greatest common divisor of two or more integers.

functions.name: GENERATE
functions.summary: Returns a table with the Cartesian product between each row in *table1* and the table that results from evaluating *table2* in the context of the current row from *table1*.

functions.name: GENERATEALL
functions.summary: Returns a table with the Cartesian product between each row in *table1* and the table that results from evaluating *table2* in the context of the current row from *table1*.

functions.name: GENERATESERIES
functions.summary: Returns a single column table containing the values of an arithmetic series.

functions.name: GEOMEAN
functions.summary: Returns the geometric mean of the numbers in a column.

functions.name: GEOMEANX
functions.summary: Returns the geometric mean of an expression evaluated for each row in a table.

functions.name: GROUPBY
functions.summary: Similar to the SUMMARIZE function, GROUPBY does not do an implicit CALCULATE for any extension columns that it adds.

functions.name: GROUPCROSSAPPLY
functions.summary: Returns a summary table over a set of groups.

functions.name: GROUPCROSSAPPLYTABLE
functions.summary: Returns a summary table over a set of groups.

functions.name: HASONEFILTER
functions.summary: Returns TRUE when the number of directly filtered values on `columnName` is one; otherwise returns `FALSE`.

functions.name: HASONEVALUE
functions.summary: Returns `TRUE` when the context for `columnName` has been filtered down to one distinct value only. Otherwise is `FALSE`.

functions.name: HOUR
functions.summary: Returns the hour as a number from 0 (12:00 A.M.) to 23 (11:00 P.M.).

functions.name: IF
functions.summary: Checks a condition, and returns one value when `TRUE`, otherwise it returns a second value.

functions.name: IF.EAGER
functions.summary: Checks a condition, and returns one value when `TRUE`, otherwise it returns a second value. Uses an *eager* execution plan which always executes the branch expressions regardless of the condition expression.

functions.name: IFERROR
functions.summary: Evaluates an expression and returns a specified value if the expression returns an error

functions.name: IGNORE
functions.summary: Modifies SUMMARIZECOLUMNS by omitting specific expressions from the BLANK/NULL evaluation.

functions.name: INDEX

functions.name: USERCULTURE
functions.summary: Returns the locale for the current user.

functions.name: USERELATIONSHIP
functions.summary: Specifies the relationship to be used in a specific calculation as the one that exists between columnName1 and columnName2.

functions.name: USERNAME
functions.summary: Returns the domain name and username from the credentials given to the system at connection time.

functions.name: USEROBJECTID
functions.summary: Returns the current user's Object ID or SID.

functions.name: USERPRINCIPALNAME
functions.summary: Returns the user principal name.

functions.name: UTCNOW
functions.summary: Returns the current UTC date and time

functions.name: UTCTODAY
functions.summary: Returns the current UTC date.

functions.name: VALUE
functions.summary: Converts a text string that represents a number to a number.

functions.name: VALUES
functions.summary: Returns a one-column table that contains the distinct values from the specified table or column.

functions.name: VAR.P
functions.summary: Returns the variance of the entire population.

functions.name: VAR.S
functions.summary: Returns the variance of a sample population.

functions.name: VARX.P
functions.summary: Returns the variance of the entire population.

functions.name: VARX.S
functions.summary: Returns the variance of a sample population.

functions.name: VDB
functions.summary: Returns the depreciation of an asset for any period you specify, including partial periods, using the double-declining balance method or some other method you specify.

functions.name: WEEKDAY
functions.summary: Returns a number from 1 to 7 identifying the day of the week of a date.

functions.name: WEEKNUM
functions.summary: Returns the week number for the given date and year according to the return_type value.

functions.name: WINDOW
functions.summary: Returns multiple rows which are positioned within the given interval.

functions.name: XIRR
functions.summary: Returns the internal rate of return for a schedule of cash flows that is not necessarily periodic.

functions.name: XNPV
functions.summary: Returns the present value for a schedule of cash flows that is not necessarily periodic.

functions.name: YEAR
functions.summary: Returns the year of a date as a four digit integer in the range 1900-9999.

functions.name: YEARFRAC
functions.summary: Calculates the fraction of the year represented by the number of whole days between two dates.

functions.name: YIELD
functions.summary: Returns the yield on a security that pays periodic interest.

functions.name: YIELDDISC
functions.summary: Returns the annual yield for a discounted security.

functions.name: YIELDMAT
functions.summary: Returns the annual yield of a security that pays interest at maturity.
